newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Trans Hex plans C$22 mln issue. [CORRECTED 14:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Trans Hex plans C$22 mln issue. [CORRECTED 14:05 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects all dollar amounts to Canadian dollars from U.S. dollars.)

Trans Hex International Ltd said it planned to issue and sell by private placement special warrants to raise up to C$22 million to fund diamond exploration in the Central African Republic, Indonesia, Zimbabwe, Namibia and Brazil.
The company said in a statement released on Thursday that a minimum of 6.5 million special warrants and a maximum of eight million would be issued and sold at C$2.75 per special warrant.

The transaction was agreed with Canaccord Capital Corp and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, who both had an option to purchase additional units equal to up to 10 percent of special warrants sold at a price of C$2.75 per unit.
Trans Hex Group Ltd, the controlling shareholder of Trans Hex International, has agreed to subscribe for about 3.2 million special warrants for C$9 million.

"Each special warrant will entitle the holder to acquire one common share and one-half of one common share purchase warrant of Trans Hex International Ltd for no additional consideration," the statement said.

"Each whole common share warrant will entitle the holder to purchase one common share for a period of two years following the closing of the private placement at a price of C$3.15 for the first year and C$3.80 thereafter," it added.
The closing of the transaction is scheduled for early October.
